title: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
description: Given a non-empty integer array `nums`, choose a non-empty contiguous subarray and optionally delete at most one element from it. After deletion, at least one element must remain. Return the largest possible sum. Input: `nums`. Output: the maximum sum.
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
